subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: The FORWARD unfused conditional-over-unconditional branch pair ('bCOND <next insn>' immediately followed by 'b <merge or epilogue>') IS reachable from C by writing the construct as a TERNARY with the empty arm FIRST, and is NOT reachable by any if/goto statement spelling. This closes the open question left by claim.law.empty-block-branch-pair-splits-forward-vs-backedge (which established that the forward variant is common and source-reachable but did not name the spelling). MEASURED LADDER on critter.c::CritterMoveSetup, each step one probe. (1) Statement spellings are inert, confirming the parent law's four-spelling null result with a fifth datapoint: converting 'if (idx < 0) goto L; <body> L:' to the plain positive 'if (idx >= 0) { <body> }' measured EXACTLY NEUTRAL, byte-identical, real 7 unchanged, multiset still DIFFERS(3t). Do not spend probes on goto-vs-if-vs-else spelling for this shape. (2) The ternary DOES emit the pair. Rewriting as 'node = (idx >= 0) ? (candidate = base[idx], candidate == NULL ? node : candidate) : node;' produced the target's branch pair and took instruction count from 76 to EXACT PARITY 77/77 with multiset DIFFERS 3t -> 2t, at the cost of an extra 'b' closing the true arm. (3) ARM ORDER selects which arm is fallthrough. Swapping to put the EMPTY arm first -- 'node = (idx < 0) ? node : (candidate = base[idx], candidate == NULL ? node : candidate);' -- moved the lone 'b' into the empty arm exactly as the target has it and drove the opcode multiset to IDENTICAL (77/77, 0t), i.e. the ENTIRE branch architecture matched. This is claim.law.if-else-arm-swap-controls-fallthrough-placement operating inside a ternary. THE PRICE, and the reason this is a law rather than a clean lever: the ternary result cannot be unified with the register of the variable being assigned. The target keeps the result in r4 (node's own register), so its else-arm is genuinely empty and its body tail carries the assignment copy 'mr r4,r0' at 0xf0; our ternary allocated the result into r0 instead, forcing the copy 'mr r0,r4' INTO the empty arm at 0xd4 and leaving the store reading r0. Net effect on the finer metric was a REGRESSION, real 7 -> 18, despite count parity and an identical multiset -- a textbook CONFLICT verdict that must be arbitrated against, not banked. (4) Forcing the unification FAILS and fails expensively. Adding a redundant self-assignment inside the ternary to make both arms yield 'node' itself ('..., node = (candidate == NULL) ? node : candidate, node)') caused MWCC to SPILL node to the stack: real 18 -> 85, insns 78 vs 77, multiset 5t with ours-only '-2 lwz -1 stw'. Do not retry register unification by self-assignment. PRACTICAL RULE: when a residual is a forward unfused branch pair, reach for the arm-swapped ternary to confirm the branch architecture is the whole gap (the multiset going IDENTICAL proves it), but expect to keep the fused if-statement version unless the assigned variable is one the allocator would have put in the ternary's result register anyway -- typically when the result is consumed immediately by a call argument or a store of a DIFFERENT variable, rather than assigned back into a live local. A function whose only residual is this pair plus the induced copy should be parked on the named mechanism 'ternary result register cannot alias the assigned local', not on 'allocator noise'.
